symptoms_en: Young caterpillars make small yellow mines in leaves and scrape the surface leaving whitish patches; full-grown ones bite holes in leaves and feed on the curd.
symptoms_hi: छोटी इल्लियाँ पत्तियों में पीली सुरंगें बनाती और सतह खुरचकर सफ़ेद धब्बे छोड़ती हैं; बड़ी इल्लियाँ पत्तियों में छेद करती हैं और फूल (कर्ड) खाती हैं।

symptoms_en.title: TNAU Agritech Portal, crop protection: pests of cole crops
symptoms_en.quote: Young caterpillars cause small yellow mines on leaves Scrapping of epidermal leaf tissues producing typical whitish patches on leaves Full-grown larvae bite holes in the leaves and feeds on curd

management_en.title: TNAU Agritech Portal, crop protection: pests of cole crops
management_en.quote: Remove and destroy all debris and stubbles after harvest of crop Grow mustard as trap crop at 2:1 ratio (cabbage: mustard) to attract DBM for oviposition at least 10 days ahead of planting of main crop Pheromone traps @12/ha Crop rotation with cucurbits, beans, peas, tomato and melon

management_en.title: TNAU Agritech Portal, crop protection: pests of cole crops

recipe_slugs.title: NITI Aayog: Empowering Farmers, Natural Farming Training Toolkit and Best Practices Guide
recipe_slugs.quote: For caterpillars and other insects: Spray Dashparni Ark or Agniastra @ 7.5 litres + 250 litres water
recipe_slugs.note: Natural-farming guide (NITI); the recipe is matched to the pest class, not tested on this crop in Malwa.

management_en: Destroy crop debris after harvest. Grow mustard as a trap crop (1 row for every 2 of cabbage) at least 10 days before planting the main crop. Set pheromone traps (12 per hectare). Rotate with cucurbits, beans, peas or tomato. Spray neem seed kernel extract 5%.
management_hi: कटाई के बाद फसल अवशेष नष्ट करें। मुख्य फसल लगाने से कम से कम 10 दिन पहले जाल-फसल के रूप में सरसों लगाएँ (गोभी की हर 2 कतार पर 1)। फेरोमोन ट्रैप लगाएँ (12 प्रति हेक्टेयर)। कद्दूवर्गीय फसलों, फलियों, मटर या टमाटर के साथ फसल चक्र अपनाएँ। नीम बीज अर्क 5% का छिड़काव करें।
